author: Sharon Tharp
title: 'The Amazing Race' Season 39 Cast Includes a Two-Time World Cup Champ - NewsBreak
text:
By Sharon Tharp ,
12 hours ago
The Amazing Race is back for its 39th season, and before the first team even leaves the starting line, host Phil Keoghan does something he's never done before: He hands every single pair an Express Pass. That means 13 teams and 13 passes but one catch — you have to use it by the end of leg six or lose it.
It all starts in Vancouver, where the Emmy-winning series kicks off a special two-night premiere event on Wednesday, Sept. 30 and Thursday, Oct. 1.
Longtime fans know Express Passes are usually earned and not given away, especially not to every single team. "This season's twists, including a new, unexpected reveal at the start line, as well as the return of some tried and tested classics, ramp up the importance of strategy," Keoghan said. "All this, along with a first-time visit to Albania, make for another thrilling race for $1 million."
From Vancouver, the route runs across five continents, nine countries and 13 cities for more than 25,000 miles — with Albania joining the race map for the first time. Along the way, teams will jump 200 feet off the catwalk at Vancouver's BC Place stadium, walk alongside camels in Morocco, and fly a paramotor over the skies of Laos.
The biggest name on the cast is Ali Krieger , 42, the two-time World Cup champion and 2016 Olympian, racing alongside fellow U.S. Women's National Team veteran Joanna Lohman , 44. Both are pro athletes and moms — Krieger out of Montclair, N.J., Lohman out of Silver Spring, Md. — and between them, they've won a Champions League title and an NWSL championship.
Other cast members include Doug Matter , 73, a retired fire chief, is running with his 19-year-old grandson Dylan (a very notable 54-year age gap). Marine officer Riley Tejcek , 29, races with her mom, healthcare executive Ann-Marie Tejcek , 56. And best friends Jody Rebhun , 44, a history teacher, and Jenn Naso , 44, a forensic scientist.
The two-night premiere airs Wednesday, Sept. 30 and Thursday, Oct. 1, both from 9:30–11:00 p.m. ET/PT on CBS, then moves to its regular Wednesday time period on Oct. 7. Episodes are also available to stream on Paramount+.
